## Source
.design/m5/45-ml-classifier.md — Open Questions Q1-Q5.

## Decisions required (provisional in #123)
- Q1 model type: A (BERT-class) vs B (LLM) vs C (rule). Default 500ms timeout suits A and C; B needs per-classifier higher timeout.
- Q2 self vs cloud: A (self-hosted only) vs B (cloud with consent) vs C (both with transparency). Provisional C.
- Q3 accuracy tracking: A (track + surface) vs B (UI add-on) vs C (auto-decay weights). Provisional A. C is dangerous (cascade risk).
- Q4 transport: A (gRPC) vs B (WebSocket) vs C (HTTP). Provisional A. Cloud providers without gRPC get wrapped in tonic-bridge adapters.
- Q5 disagreement UX: A (side-by-side) vs B (aggregate + side-by-side) vs C (separate Disagreement observation). Provisional A; talk to moderators before locking in B/C.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Five decisions recorded as `--kind decision` comments.

- Blocks #125 (Q4 shapes the transport choice).
